text: {"status":"answered","answer":"For wire transfers, under the Wire Transfer Policy (Rev 2026-02, which applies to Retail accounts): a domestic wire must be received and verified by 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a business day to go out the same business day. For an international wire, the cutoff is 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time (delivery to the beneficiary can still take one to five business days). Requests after the cutoff, or on a non-business day, are processed the next business day.
